---
title: "🤼 Wrestler Rosters"
subtitle: "Search every national championship participant, their collegiate program, and their tournament record."
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

source("_setup.R")

reactable(
  roster_df,
  theme = tbl_theme,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 15,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  pageSizeOptions = c(10, 15, 25, 50, 100),
  columns = list(
    year = colDef(name = "Year", width = 85, align = "center"),
    weight_class = colDef(name = "Weight", width = 90, align = "center"),
    wrestler = colDef(name = "Wrestler", minWidth = 160),
    school = colDef(name = "School", minWidth = 160),
    record = colDef(name = "Record (W-L)", width = 120, align = "center"),
    place = colDef(name = "Tournament Finish", minWidth = 150, cell = badge_place)
  )
)
```
